request.system:
You extract facts a company states about its business from one excerpt of a company document: orders and contract
wins, new named customers or programs, price increases and pricing actions, capacity additions and commitments, lead
times, new segments or business lines, governance events (auditor changes, material weaknesses, going-concern doubts,
restatements), export exposure, customer concentration, and capital spending, financing, backlog and obligations.
Extract only facts the excerpt states explicitly. Never calculate, infer, combine, annualize or convert numbers.
For every fact, copy the exact supporting text into "quote": verbatim, at most 60 words, and it must appear exactly
in the excerpt. If a number's meaning depends on nearby words (a unit, a period, "approximately"), include them in
the quote.
Set "as_of" to the date the excerpt says the fact was true or was announced (an award date, a quarter end): never a
future or effective date, and never later than the document's publication. If the excerpt states none, leave it null.
Set "period_label" only to the fiscal or calendar period a number covers, as written ("fiscal 2027", "the second
quarter of 2026"); leave it null for anything else, such as a date, a term or a duration.
For a range, set "value_low" and "value_high" and leave "value" null. Keep every number in the unit the excerpt
writes it in.
An event needs no number: a named new customer, a new segment or business line, a governance event. A measure (a lead
time, a backlog, capital spending, a share of revenue) is a fact only with its number.
A governance event is "added" when the excerpt reports it, and "removed" only when the excerpt says one reported
earlier was remediated or resolved; controls the excerpt calls effective are neither.
Allowed fact types: capex_guidance (A company's stated expectation for capital expenditures); capex_reported (Reported capital expenditures (XBRL PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment and text)); backlog (Stated backlog/orders (industrial, contractors)); rpo (Remaining performance obligations (XBRL RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation and text)); lead_time (A stated lead time for equipment or capacity); capacity_addition (New or expanded capacity: MW/GW, factories, square feet, sites, with timing); commitment_lease (Leases not yet commenced, data-center leases, lease commitments); commitment_purchase (Purchase obligations, capacity/compute purchase commitments, take-or-pay); commitment_ppa (Power purchase and energy supply agreements (counterparty, MW, term)); financing (Debt, JV or SPV financing tied to AI/data-center infrastructure); customer_concentration (Stated share of revenue from the largest customers); supply_link (A named customer/supplier/partner relationship tied to AI infrastructure); utility_load (Utility large-load or data-center pipeline (GW, requests, contracts)); risk_factor_change (Added, removed or modified risk-factor paragraphs on AI, data centers, power or supply chain); order_win (A stated order or contract win with value, customer or segment); customer_win (A new named customer or program); price_increase (A stated price increase or pricing action); new_segment (A new reportable segment or business line); governance_flag (Auditor change, material weakness, going concern, restatement (added or removed)); export_exposure (A stated export share or overseas order book (India: US/data-center exports)).
Use a subject_key from this vocabulary: capex_guidance:<period>, capex_reported:<period>, backlog:total, backlog:<segment>, rpo:total, rpo:next_12m_pct, lead_time:<equipment>, capacity:mw:site_<slug>, capacity:<unit>:<slug>, lease_not_commenced:total, purchase_obligations:total, ppa:<counterparty>:<site>, financing:<instrument>:<date>, customer_concentration:top1, customer_concentration:<topn>, link:<counterparty>, large_load:pipeline_gw, risk:<paragraph_hash>, order_win:<slug>, customer_win:<slug>, price_increase:<slug>, new_segment:<slug>, governance:auditor_change:added, governance:material_weakness:added, governance:material_weakness:removed, governance:going_concern:added, governance:going_concern:removed, governance:restatement:added, governance:restatement:removed, export_exposure:share_pct, export_exposure:overseas_order_book. If none fits, use "other:<short-slug>".
Do not extract anything about share prices, stock performance, valuation, analyst views, ratings, share repurchases,
dividends or trading. If the excerpt states that previous guidance is withdrawn, set "withdrawn": true.
Return only the tool call.

Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

We continue to monitor supply chain conditions, including lead time trends for transformers and switchgear.

Total backlog reached $13.2 billion at quarter end, a record for the company.

Backlog from data center customers was $4.1 billion, up from the prior year.

Lead times for large power transformers extended to 147 weeks during the quarter.

Our stock price rose 23% during the quarter, and two analysts upgraded their ratings to buy.

Our largest customer, a hyperscale data center operator, accounted for 26% of revenue in the quarter.

We entered into a multi-year agreement to supply power transformers and switchgear to Nimbus Compute for its AI data center campuses.
